entries.title: Azure UK South data residency restriction
entries.summary: AtliQ must access Customer personal data only through Novaterra's Azure UK South environment and is prohibited from copying such data outside of that environment.
entries.quote: Customer personal data shall be accessed only through the Customer's Azure UK South environment, and shall not be copied outside it.
entries.endRule: Term (completion of SOW-1, targeted for 17 October 2025)
entries.notes: Target date for completion of SOW-1 is 17 October 2025 as set out in Schedule 1.

entries.title: Assignment of IngestIQ background framework
entries.summary: AtliQ assigned all intellectual property rights in its pre-existing IngestIQ framework and deliverables to Novaterra, and agreed not to use, copy, license, or create derivative works of IngestIQ for any third party.
entries.quote: The Supplier hereby assigns to the Customer, with full title guarantee and by way of present assignment of future rights, all Intellectual Property Rights in the Assigned Materials, with effect from the date of their creation or (for the Supplier Framework) from the date of payment of the Framework Transfer Fee.

relatedClauses.quote: "Supplier Framework" means the Supplier's pre-existing data ingestion and data-quality framework known as IngestIQ, as described in Schedule 3, in the version incorporated into the Deliverables.

The Supplier shall not, and shall procure that its Affiliates and subcontractors shall not, use, copy, license, sell or create derivative works of the Assigned Materials for any third party, or provide any third party with services that make use of the Assigned Materials.

The Supplier shall deliver to the Customer the complete source code, documentation and version history of the Supplier Framework and shall not retain any copy, save one archival copy for the purpose of performing and supporting the Services under this Agreement.

entries.notes: AtliQ assigned its pre-existing tool IngestIQ v1.4 for a one-off Framework Transfer Fee of GBP 12,000.
